presentation.title: Shipment lost at sea
lines: {supplier} has bad news: the container with your {qty} × {product} ({total}) was lost at sea.
They can ship it again, {days} days later than planned.

choices.label: Ask for a re-ship
choices.detail: {supplier} sends new stock at no extra cost. It arrives {days} days later than planned.
choices.outcome: The supplier will ship again. Expect it {days} days late.

choices.label: Take the refund
choices.detail: Escrow orders only: the contract sends your {total} back and the order is cancelled. Paid another way? Then a re-ship is all there is.
choices.outcome: The escrow contract returned your money. The fee is not refunded.
